scenario: String equality comparison at runtime (LSTR.3.1: codepoint by codepoint) — a rule gated on `d.state == "on"` fires once for each of d1 and d3 and not for d2. Named for the LFAC.1.3 heading (`ttl` facts), which it does not test; its schema is `logical`.
rules_ds:
schema Device scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    state: String mutable

rule on_device:
    Device d where d.state == "on"
->
    log info "device on"
